title: Health & Cancer Awareness Seminar jointly organized by International Medical Information Centre (IMIC Ltd) + Farrer Park Hospital, Singapore + Club 89 Ltd on + Blue Sky Charitable Foundation
excerpt: Health & Cancer Awareness Seminar jointly organized by International Medical Information Centre (IMIC Ltd) + Farrer Park Hospital, Singapore + Club 89 Ltd o...
content:
Health & Cancer Awareness Seminar jointly organized by International Medical Information Centre (IMIC Ltd) + Farrer Park Hospital, Singapore + Club 89 Ltd on + Blue Sky Charitable Foundation (BSCF) on “Prostate, Breast and Gynecological Cancers”Club 89 Ltd., Blue Sky Charitable Foundation (BSCF), International Medical Information Centre (IMIC Ltd.), and Farrer Park Hospital in Singapore, have jointly organized a health and cancer awareness seminar on “prostate, breast, and gynecological cancers” at Club 89 Ltd. premises on June 10, 2023. Ms. Ayesha Siddiqua Shelley, Additional Commissioner of Taxes & Founder and Head Adviser of The Blue Sky Charitable Foundation (BSCF), was the chairperson of this session. Dr. Lee Fang Jann, Senior Consultant Urologist from Farrer Park Hospital Singapore, highlighted the prevention and management of prostate enlargement, prostate cancer, urinary tract infection (UTI), and kidney stones, respectively. While Dr. Tania Rahman Mitul, Consultant Gynecologist, Tejgaon Thana Complex Hospital, Dhaka, has presided over the prevention and management of breast and gynecological cancers, Ms. Ayesha Siddiqua Shelley, chairperson of the seminar, gave an introductory speech in the program and presented the activities of the Blue Sky Charitable Foundation (BSCF).  Ms. Farzana Wali Liza, Chairman, International Medical Information Centre (IMIC Ltd.) & Bangladesh Office, Farrer Park Hospital, Singapore, and Ms. Hue Swee Yen, Manager, Payor Relations & Sales; Customer Relations Department, presided over the vote of thanks following the seminar. The main objective of the seminar is to update the audience on better treatment modalities and aids to undergo for the appropriate medical options. IMIC Dhaka office helps patients arrange visa assistance, air ambulance arrangements, emergency hospital admission, doctor’s appointments, and all types of overseas medical logistics support for more than 56 hospitals in Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, and India. For any kind of medical emergency or more information, please email maruf@imic.com.bd or farzana@imic.com.bd or contact the 24-hour helpline at 01710 802000.

content:
Cancer is not a complex disease, and nowadays, cancer disease can
be cured if patient has been properly diagnosed from authentic sources and
started proper treatment within a short period of time. Early detection and early With treatment, cancer can be cured. In Bangladesh, every year more than 1 lakh 56
thousand cancer patients are newly diagnosed and 1 lakh 8 thousand patients die
(according to Globocan 2020 data). More than 80 % of cancer patients are
diagnosed in the last stage, where doctors cannot do the curative treatment,
and only require palliative treatment. We have to be aware of cancer disease
causative factors and should be known on the full disease factors. How can do
the diagnose, treatment and prevention of the cancer disease. When anyone has
any kind of abnormal change of body part, so that should be visit the
doctor.
